other_conditions: Applicant should have adequate knowledge and experience of the scheme.
Applicant should not have misused any previous loan obtained from the Corporation.
Applicant should not have any other similar unit.
Applicant should not be a defaulter of the Corporation or banks.
benefits_summary: Provides loans up to ₹50,000 per unit with 10% margin money and a subsidy of up to 50% of the project cost, capped at ₹10,000.
